title: Data Analyst
jd_text:
Data Analyst
Company: Contoso Insights
Requirements: advanced SQL, Tableau dashboards, Python data cleaning, stakeholder reporting, ETL pipelines, Excel.
Responsibilities: build dashboards, clean datasets, present insights to business stakeholders.

title: Analytics Engineer
jd_text:
Analytics Engineer
Company: Streamly
Requirements: Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, ETL, data modeling, Tableau, technical documentation.
Build reliable pipelines and analytics-ready tables.

title: Risk Analyst Intern
jd_text:
Risk Analyst Intern
Company: Harbor Insurance
Requirements: credit risk, Monte Carlo, Python, R, claims modeling, statistical modeling, SQL, probability.
Support pricing and reserving analytics.

title: Quantitative Analytics Intern
jd_text:
Quantitative Analytics Intern
Requirements: Python, C++, Monte Carlo simulation, pricing models, performance benchmarking, SQL.
Evaluate computational approaches for pricing libraries.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jd_text:
BI Analyst
Requirements: Tableau, SQL, Excel, stakeholder communication, dashboard development, KPI reporting.
Translate metrics into narratives for marketing and ops.

title: Junior Data Scientist
jd_text:
Junior Data Scientist
Requirements: Python, scikit-learn, XGBoost, feature engineering, model evaluation, SQL, ROC-AUC.
Do not invent cloud experience if not present.

title: Data Analyst
jd_text: Data Analyst. SQL and Python required. Remote.

title: Senior Data Analyst
jd_text:
Senior Data Analyst
Must have: SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Airflow, ETL, data cleaning, feature engineering, A/B testing, statistics, hypothesis testing, stakeholder management, documentation, Excel, Spark, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Power BI, machine learning, XGBoost, scikit-learn, Monte Carlo, credit risk, claims, financial modeling, optimization, NLP, LLMs, AWS, Azure, GCP.
Prefer 5+ years experience.

title: Frontend Engineer
jd_text:
Frontend Engineer
Requirements: React, TypeScript, CSS, accessibility, design systems.
No data stack required.

title: Operations Analyst
jd_text:
Operations Analyst
Requirements: SQL, Python, dashboarding, stakeholder reporting, process automation, Excel, quality risk indicators.
Experience with large operational datasets preferred.
